legislation_groups.summary_for_ai: Training content must promote safe work practices consistent with OSHA expectations.
content_rules: Never reward or normalise unsafe behaviour
Model appropriate use of safety equipment
scenario_rules: Workplace scenarios must include realistic hazards
Unsafe decisions must result in corrective outcomes
Incident reporting must follow reasonable workplace expectations
assessment_rules: Correct answers must align with safe work practices
Incorrect answers must explain safety risks
Assessment tasks must not encourage unsafe actions

legislation_groups.summary_for_ai: Learner and employee information must be handled responsibly and confidentially.
content_rules: Use fictional or anonymised personal information
Avoid unnecessary collection of personal data
Model secure handling of digital and paper records
scenario_rules: Scenarios involving records must demonstrate confidentiality
Personal data must not be shared casually or publicly
assessment_rules: Do not require learners to provide real personal information
Privacy-respecting behaviour must be reinforced in feedback
common_mistakes_to_avoid: Using real personal data in examples

legislation_groups.summary_for_ai: Training must be inclusive and free from discrimination or harassment.
scenario_rules: Discrimination or harassment must never be rewarded
Inappropriate behaviour must be corrected through feedback
assessment_rules: Correct answers must support fair treatment

legislation_groups.summary_for_ai: Training content should be clear, fair, and appropriate for workforce learning contexts.
content_rules: Learning materials must be clear and achievable
Content must match stated learning outcomes
scenario_rules: Tasks must be solvable using provided information
assessment_rules: Assessment must be fair and reasonable
Do not trick learners with irrelevant complexity

prompt_injection_block.system_instruction: All generated content must comply with U.S. OSHA safety expectations, privacy principles, equal employment opportunity requirements, and fair workforce training practices. Safety, inclusivity, and learner fairness must be prioritised at all times. Use American English spelling.
